The best couch co-op games on PS Plus

Sometimes the best way to play is side by side, sharing one screen and one bowl of snacks. These are our ten favourite couch co-op games on PS Plus right now, all playable together on a single console. Each one says how many can join in, so you can find one that fits your sofa. The full list of games with local co-op follows.

What counts as couch co-op

Couch co-op means two or more people playing together on one PS4 or PS5, on a shared or split screen, on the same side. Games where you can only play against each other, like most fighting and sports games, aren't counted here, and neither are games that need a second console.

We check every game on this list by hand for local co-op and how many players it supports, rather than trusting the box, because “multiplayer” on a store page often means online only.

1

Overcooked! All You Can Eat

Up to 4 players on one console · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 84 · about 12 h main story

Chaotic kitchen co-op where you chop, cook and serve against the clock in kitchens that split apart, slide around or catch fire. It's simple enough for anyone to pick up and guaranteed to have you shouting at each other within minutes. This edition bundles both games and all their extra content.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

Rayman Legends

Up to 4 players on one console · PS4 · Metascore 92 · about 10 h main story

The best-reviewed couch co-op game on the service: a bright 2D platformer where up to four of you run, jump and punch through gorgeous hand-drawn worlds. The musical levels, played in time with the soundtrack, are a highlight.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Sackboy: A Big Adventure

Up to 4 players on one console · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 79 · about 11 h main story

A cheerful, inventive 3D platformer starring the knitted hero from LittleBigPlanet. Some levels can only be reached together, and the music levels set to pop songs are a joy. A great pick for families.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

Terraria

Up to 4 players on one console · PS4 · Metascore 81 · 76% recommend on OpenCritic · about 52 h main story

Dig, build, explore and fight your way through a huge 2D world that keeps surprising you with bosses, biomes and secrets. Split-screen lets everyone go their own way, then regroup to take on the next boss together.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Untitled Goose Game

2 players on one console · PS4 · Metascore 81 · about 3 h main story

You're a horrible goose, and the village is your playground: steal hats, ruin picnics and honk at everyone. The two-player mode lets a second goose join the mischief, which makes it twice as funny. Short, silly and perfect for a lazy afternoon.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Vampire Survivors

Up to 4 players on one console · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 86 · about 15 h main story

You walk, the weapons fire on their own, and within minutes the screen fills with thousands of monsters and dazzling attacks. It's very hard to stop playing, and even better with friends on the same sofa.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince

Up to 4 players on one console · PS4 · Metascore 80 · about 10 h main story

A gorgeous fairy-tale puzzle platformer where a wizard, a knight and a thief combine their skills to get past each obstacle. With friends, every puzzle turns into a creative argument about the best way through.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Children of Morta

2 players on one console · PS4 · Metascore 80 · about 14 h main story

A hand-drawn action RPG about a family of heroes defending their mountain home, with each family member playing differently. A second player can jump in as another member of the family, and the story is surprisingly moving.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

LEGO City Undercover

2 players on one console · PS4 · Metascore 77 · about 15 h main story

A funny open-world LEGO adventure where you play an undercover cop in a city full of jokes and secrets. The split-screen co-op makes it one of the best ways to play with younger kids.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Human: Fall Flat

2 players on one console · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 70 · about 6.3 h main story

A physics puzzle game where you control a wobbly, floppy character through dream-like levels. Solving things is hard, and failing is hilarious, especially with a friend grabbing onto you at the worst possible moment.

Questions

Do I need PS Plus to play couch co-op?

No. Playing together on one console doesn't need a subscription. You only need PS Plus Extra to have these games from the catalogue in the first place.

Do I need a second controller?

Yes, each player needs their own controller. A PS4 controller works for PS4 games, and PS5 controllers work for PS5 games.

What are the best couch co-op games for kids?

Sackboy: A Big Adventure, Rayman Legends and LEGO City Undercover are bright, forgiving and easy for younger players. Our games for kids list has more.

What's the best couch co-op game for two?

Untitled Goose Game is a perfect short pair game, and Children of Morta and LEGO City Undercover are built around two players. Any of the four-player games work brilliantly with two as well.

What are the best couch co-op games for four players?

Overcooked! All You Can Eat, Rayman Legends, Sackboy, Terraria, Vampire Survivors and Trine 4 all take four players on one console.

What about split-screen shooters?

They're rare on PS Plus Extra. PS Plus Premium's classics include a few, like Resident Evil 5 and TimeSplitters 2. Our online co-op list has the best shooters to play with friends over the internet.
